prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: an opaque 1024 by 1536 pixel portrait scenery illustration for the Split beer game.
Input images: Image 1 is only a style, material, and composition reference. Create a NEW setting described below; do not edit or copy the reference location.
Style/medium: the same richly painted travel-postcard world as the reference, with hand-painted gouache color, fine pencil detail, tactile wood and fabric, lived-in architecture, and natural atmospheric perspective.
Composition/framing: full-bleed 2:3 portrait at seated eye level. A large empty foreground tabletop extends from a clean, almost horizontal rear edge at about 60% of image height to the bottom border. The entire foreground is clear. Keep the central x30–70% of the composition quiet for a live beer vessel the game will draw separately. People are small distant adults in the background, off the main central axis.
Scene: a comfortable Midwest living room during Thanksgiving football afternoon. Low golden afternoon sun enters an original-looking broad window onto a yard of russet and gold autumn trees. Small grown friends sit in comfortable chairs around the far room, with soft knit blankets on the chair backs. A television on the far side of the room shows only a generic green American-football field with small indistinct players, no score overlay, team insignia, numbers, or text. The foreground is an entirely empty warm wooden coffee/bar table, its rear edge at about 60% height. Quiet cream walls, warm wood and an autumn amber/soft-blue palette. Familiar relaxed afternoon at home.
Constraints: no foreground vessels, glassware, bottles, cups, cans, drinks, food, plates, labels, brands, logos, readable text, interface, border, or watermark. No objects resting on the foreground table. No Halloween faces, jack-o-lanterns, Christmas decorations, Santa, colonial costumes, fantasy features, or close-up people. All Thanksgiving meal details remain distant background elements. Make the place and social warmth carry the scene.
inspection: Inspected original style/material reference and generated scene. Warm Midwest living room, adult friends in chairs, autumn window, knit blankets, distant generic football television. Entire foreground wood table clear; no branded overlay or readable text. Actual rear tabletop edge is higher than the requested approximate 60% and is recorded from the exported composition.
tableMeasurement: Visual inspection and strongest central 201-pixel row gradient at the tabletop rear edge.
